title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (13/20): The Last Librarian
note_en: Repeating 一 + measure word + 地 turns it into an adverb meaning "one by one": 他把旧书一本一本地放回书架 "he put the old books back on the shelves one by one." The measure word must match the noun, so books are 一本一本, pages 一页一页 (also in this text: 一页一页翻看 "turning page after page"), and people 一个一个.
